title: Station to shelf
role: Team 1780’s 2025 REEFSCAPE robot steers to the coral station and holds its receiver under the chute for the first feed.

cad.title: 1780 · full swerve robot
cad.scope: Rotate the stowed R4 robot to see its four swerve corners, receiver and two red bumper covers. White 1780 artwork sits on all four outward faces. The public STEP uses project-drawn shapes for purchased components.

results.claim: Both 65 kg approaches docked before the first feed
results.conditions: The mirrored approaches reached the docking gate at 20.285 s and 20.330 s. The first feed was scheduled for 21.100 s.
results.limit: Four adverse cases missed the docking gate. The film follows one nominal approach.

results.claim: The receiver held the first piece through 27.03 s
results.conditions: Both simulated approach signs reached the in-band receiver state at 22.912 s. Two solver step sizes reproduced it.
results.limit: The simulation ends at the station. Loaded departure, delivery and a scored piece still need evidence.

results.claim: The selected drawing leaves 170 g under the inspection limit
results.conditions: The matched 944-item bill puts the upper estimate at 51.993 kg, against a 52.163 kg limit. The calculation uses the machined shelf, the repaired rear electronics and the specified cable cuts.
results.limit: Uniform 1 m supply cuts put the same estimate 4.9 g over. The drawing predates the R4 bumper markings. The opening simulations use separate 65 kg and 72 kg operating assumptions.

build.configuration: Four swerve modules sit on a 564 mm wheelbase and 554 mm track. The public model points all four wheels forward to show the layout. The student Fusion chassis uses the individual supplier fork orientations. The Fusion handoff lists the archives students can open.
The shelf and guide arms sit above the four independently steered wheels. The public view shows the receiver stowed and both red bumper covers installed.
Two red covers wrap the chassis. White 1780 numerals read from each outward face. The side markings stay on individual covers so the two halves can separate for service.

media.caption: Nominal approach at real time. The field view shows the path to the station. The four-wheel diagram follows simulated steering and rolling speeds at 10 frames per second.
media.description: A field replay beside four labeled wheel directions, with the match clock and station event visible.
